The semicircle has endpoints on the \(x\)-axis at \((-7,0)\) and \((7,0)\), so its diameter is

\[
7-(-7)=14.
\]

Thus the radius is half the diameter:

\[
\frac{14}{2}=7.
\]

Therefore, the radius is

\[
\boxed{7\text{ units}}
\]
